_about: Words built into the app that speak as Zzzap Official. Every one goes through Say It Like Zzzap (Stacy 2026-11-15). Claude keeps this list current: a new built-in Official line is added here in the same change, with what it should say in plain words. "current" is what the app ships (picked 11/15). Picks come back to Claude as a file (Save for Claude).

groups.name: People card
groups.where: Home, until 3 people are connected (ladder step 2). The other ladder cards are edited in the Ladder tab.

items.label: 2. Bring in 3 people
items.plain: Encourage them to invite people they ask for advice. Zzzap works best once 3 of their people are on it. The title is a live count like "1 of 3 people connected" and stays as is; only the text and the button come from this pick.
items.buttonFor: a page for inviting people by text

current.title: 1 of 3 people connected
current.body: Think of the people you already ask for advice. Zzzap works best once 3 of them are on it. Who's first?

groups.name: Watch How screen
groups.where: Opens from the Lock Screen card's button: a looping video of a Lock Screen vote (LockScreenVoteSheet in NotesLadder.swift)

items.label: Title and the line under the video
items.plain: A short title for a screen that plays a looping video of someone voting from a zzzap notification, and one short line under the video telling them how: long-press the notification, then tap an answer. The title shows at the top of the screen, so keep it very short.

current.title: Press, tap, done
current.body: Your crew asked. Long-press the notification, then tap your answer.

groups.name: New in 1.2
groups.where: A card first on Home (only a warning goes ahead) for people who already had Zzzap, the first time they open 1.2; its button opens a tour (WhatsNewView.swift). Each tour page is a looping demo video, "New in 1.2", the title, and one yellow button. On the tour pages only the title and the button show; the line under the title is not used (few words, the video explains).

items.label: The Home card
items.plain: Tell them, excited, that 1.2 is here with something we've wanted to give them: they can text a zzzap to anyone, even friends who don't have Zzzap, and those friends vote from the text and can be in their circles. Short title, one short line. The button opens a short video tour.
items.buttonFor: a short video tour of what's new

current.title: Say hi to 1.2
current.body: Something we've wanted to give you and your people for a while. Want the quick tour?

items.label: Page 1: text a zzzap
items.plain: Announce that they can now send a zzzap by text to anyone, including people who don't have Zzzap. Those people vote on a web page from the text, no app needed, Android too. Very short title, it's the whole message. The button opens New with their contacts showing so they can try it now.
items.buttonFor: the New tab, open at picking people from Contacts to text a zzzap to

current.title: Now by text
current.body: Got people who aren't on Zzzap? Text them a Strike from Messages. They vote right on a web page, no app needed, Android too.

items.label: Page 2: people not on Zzzap in circles
items.plain: Announce that their circles can now hold people who aren't on Zzzap, like the friend who'll never get the app. Pick the circle and those people get the zzzap by text. Very short title. The button opens their circles.
items.buttonFor: their circles, where they can add someone not on Zzzap

current.title: Circles for everyone
current.body: Your circles can now hold people who aren't on Zzzap. Who's the one in your crew who'll never get the app? Add them, pick the circle, and they get the zzzap by text.
